This was a pretty hard feature to implement but I got it done today. Heads-up: the icons for this feature will be re-designed.

How does it work? When you click the expando button, ajax request is sent to the server with the ID of the message user wants to load. The server queries the database, fetches the message content if any is found and sends it back. Javascript on client side grabs the received data and manipulates DOMs to show the message content.

This one took about 3 hours to implement and (aside from javascript code) I am quite happy about how it turned out :) Next up? Expandos for videos? We'll see :)
